name: gommage-daemon-user-recovery-still-allowed
note: GUARD: 03-recovery.yaml allows the gommage-daemon user-scope recovery commands and loads before 35-system.yaml (03 < 35), so they keep working after the new persistence gates land. The new systemctl gate only surfaces sched.systemd:write for system-scope (default/--system) units, never --user, so this recovery command stays allowed. If a regression made --user match the system gate, this fixture would flip from allow to ask_picto.
